summary: Figma Education gives verified higher-education students the Professional plan free for one year (educators two years), including Figma Make, Figma Sites (one publishable site), and 3,000 AI credits per month. Access renews with re-verification via SheerID.
claim_steps: Create a Figma account using your school email.
Go to https://www.figma.com/education/apply, select Higher ed, and complete SheerID verification.
Once approved, create an Education team to start building with Professional features and AI credits.
